definitions.explanation: A label attached to merchandise showing its price.

examples.japanese: {値札|ねふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: To look at the price tag.

examples.japanese: {値札|ねふだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いていない→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: There is no price tag attached.

examples.japanese: ⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{値札|ねふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}して→外す：02394_hazusu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please remove the price tag because it's a gift.

notes:
A label or tag attached to merchandise showing its price. Commonly seen in stores, markets, and when discussing shopping.

FORMS:
⟦{値|ね}→値：03527_ne⟧ (price, value) + ⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧ (tag, card). The kanji ⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧ is also read さつ ('banknote').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {値札|ねふだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to have a price tag
- {値札|ねふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to remove a price tag
- {値札|ねふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the price tag
- {値札|ねふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}け{替|か}える: to switch price tags

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧: price (general)
- ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: price (formal, written)
- ⟦{定価|ていか}→定価：04066_teika⟧: list price, retail price
